你這麼容易累，不一定是力氣不夠。: If you get tired easily, it isn't necessarily that you lack energy.
可能是你一直開著所有的接收器：別人的情緒、現場的氣氛、沒說出口的話，全部都收進來: You may have every receiver switched on: other people's feelings, the mood of the room, the things no one says. You take it all in.
這不是要你變冷漠，而是要練習：什麼時候打開，什麼時候關上。: This isn't about becoming cold. It's about practicing when to open up and when to close.
今天找 10 分鐘，把手機、訊息、別人的事都先關掉，只聽自己的呼吸。: Today, find 10 minutes. Put away your phone, your messages and other people's business, and just listen to your own breathing.
